name: wme-client-portal
description: Dual-Portal Talent & Booking Management System (WME-style) Scaffold

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:up: sudo pg_ctlcluster 16 main start && sudo service redis-server start
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev && npx prisma db seed
scripts.build:all: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.start:all: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "cd backend && npm run start:prod" "cd frontend && npm run start"
